title: Yangian Doubles and off-Shell Bethe Vectors
summary: Off-shell Bethe vectors for a generic $\fg$ invariant integrable model are constructed through the currents of the Yangian doubles of the classical series. These off-shell Bethe vectors are shown to satisfy the defining properties which were used in \cite{LPR-RR} to prove the rectangular recurrence relations and verify the eigenvalue property of the on-shell Bethe vectors in $\ggo$-invariant integrable models.
